default.description: The main window's capabilities: core IPC (invoke/events), the custom title bar's window controls (drag, minimize, maximize, close), the folder-open and archive-save dialogs, the clipboard the Copy and Paste actions use, the opener for external URLs, Reveal in File Explorer and opening a file in its default application — every path the workspace and the dump viewer extract to, the allow-open-path scope must name them all (** — an empty scope answers Not allowed to open path for every path), and the OS notification behind the close-to-hide notice (module 19, §17.2).

remote-relay.description: The hidden Relay webview of Remote Access (docs/ggs-remote-plan.md §8.4): core IPC only — invoke, Channel, events. Window controls, dialogs, the clipboard and the opener are served by the remote browser itself, never here.
